action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull stable version
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git fetch origin && git checkout fix/esm-stable && git reset --hard 755b0748 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Checkout:", stdout.read().decode())

# Build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -8")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check dist
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
